text.p: -- HSBC James Capel said on Tuesday it had downgraded its rating for Brazilian brewery Companhia Cervejaria Brahma SA to long-term buy from buy.
-- The firm set a one-year target price of $811 per 1,000 shares in Sao Paulo.

-- "Even though we foresee good earnings results and strong performance relative to its peers, we are anticipating slower beer consumption growth in Brazil for the coming years, while returns from the investment in the new plant in Rio (de Janeiro) will take longer to translate into higher profitability," HSBC James Capel wrote in a report.
-- The company's shares were up six reais to 770 in Sao Paulo.
